image.prompt:
Product photograph of one isolated object, shot from a HIGH THREE-QUARTER ANGLE: the camera is well above the object and tilted down about 30 degrees, so the top of the object is clearly visible along with its front and one side. Not a straight-on elevation.

The object: Standalone single-storey small PTT fuel station building, detailed front elevation with a glazed shop frontage and an attached flat forecourt canopy carried on two square clad columns, dark blue fascia band with a red lower stripe carrying the PTT wordmark and flame device, recessed downlight panels in the white canopy soffit, plain rendered side and rear walls with a service door, flat roof with a low parapet and roof-mounted air-conditioning condensers Materials: blue and red printed composite fascia panels and white perforated soffit at the front, plate glass, flat painted render on side and rear walls, galvanised roof plant.

Form: build the object from a few simple, chunky, closed volumes. Prefer solid panels over lattice, mesh, grilles or perforated screens; keep any openings few, large and clearly separated. No thin spindly protrusions, no wires, no chains, no fringes, no lace, no fine filigree, no dense repeated slots or cut-outs. Keep the silhouette simple and readable from every side. Keep the object's SHAPE simple; richness must come from the surface finish, wear and materials rather than from intricate geometry. The object is still photoreal and highly detailed in its texture -- only its form is simple.

Framing: long-lens near-orthographic perspective, minimal foreshortening. The object is perfectly centred and occupies about 75% of the frame height, with clear empty margin on all four sides. The whole object is in frame; nothing is cropped.

Background: completely flat seamless neutral 50% grey (#808080). The object floats in empty space against an infinite seamless backdrop, photographed as a cut-out with nothing underneath it. There is no surface for it to rest on and nothing for it to cast a shadow onto. No floor, no ground plane, no horizon line, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no vignette, no gradient.

Lighting: flat even studio illumination from all sides, soft and shadowless, like a lightbox. No strong key light, no rim light, no coloured light, no specular blowout, no dramatic highlights. Colours must read as true albedo.

One object only, nothing else in frame. No people, no hands, no other props, no packaging, no watermarks, no measurement annotations, no arrows, no borders, no drop shadow. Apart from the building's own signage described above, there is no other text or lettering anywhere in the frame.

Photoreal, sharp focus edge to edge, clean and undamaged geometry, realistic materials and surface wear. Not stylised, not cartoon, not low-poly, not a 3D render preview, not a wireframe.

license.notice: Real trademark: PTT / OR. The repo's MIT licence covers this asset's code, not the mark; anyone shipping it needs their own trademark clearance.

review.critique: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.94 -- not a pass self-score. 3336/16000 triangles, 11/12 draw calls, 7/8 materials, 11/16 unique geometries. Fourth build, revision e (2026-09-03): both marks regenerated with Nano Banana 2 and sized by their own ink (the flame at 0.61, the word on a level baseline) after the user found the logo tilted and the flame too narrow; revision d (2026-09-02): the canopy doubled to 6 m on a 10 m module, the +X edge banded like the front, a fresh symmetrised NB2 flame -- over revision c's six-bay shopfront and -X window and revision b's full-width kiosk (all user direction); the mark at the plate's real size (emblem 0.78 m, x 0.60..1.80), rust on the panels the plate has it on, deck / membrane / frame / glass tones re-measured off the plate, every NB2 texture regenerated.

featureReviews.evidence: Envelope built at 8.00 x 4.60 x 10.00 m (x -4.00 .. +4.00 navy boards, z -5.00 rear ring .. +5.00 board; declared depth raised 7.0 -> 10.0 by user direction, the canopy doubled). ONE 8 x 10 slab at 4.60 with a 1.2 m edge fascia (soffit 3.40, red 3.40..3.56, navy 3.56..4.50, white coping 4.50..4.60) and a 0.30 m parapet ring, on two 0.42 m columns at x +-1.95, z 4.22; the kiosk the FULL WIDTH of the slab under its rear 4 m, x -3.89..3.99, z -4.995..-1.0, its +X and rear walls FLUSH with the slab faces -- the plate's right half shows one continuous white face carrying the service door, which the second build stepped in by 0.45 m. Fascia proportions read off the plate's right column (258:75:12:7 px for column:navy:red:coping); ONE straight upstand at z -1.0 divides the roof and the 6 m front strip is the only open canopy -- built to the user's direction (twice the plate's ~3 m overhang).
featureReviews.notes: Fourth build, revision b (2026-09-02): full-width kiosk on user direction, replacing the L-plan. Residuals: the plate shows backdrop between the left column and the glazing, which this plan does not explain; the plate is projectively inconsistent, so the column x and the kiosk's -X wall carry +-0.3 m; the fresh Meshy v7 proxy reads the plate 42% deeper than the kit's shared 7.0 m module and mirrors the plan (symmetry_mode=auto), so the module and the plate win.

featureReviews.evidence: Revision e: BOTH marks are fresh Nano Banana 2 edits of the plate's 8x crops (sign/compose7.py). The flame (two petals parting at a V notch over a hollow drop ring, all white) has its own ink aspect 0.607 against the plate's 33 x 58 px = 0.57 and a mirror IoU of 0.995 before symmetrising; the wordmark was asked for a level baseline, ~12 degree slant and a p descender, and measures its two t bottoms level (503/503 px) with the p 126 px below -- the old word (~25 degrees, no descender) is what read as 'on an angle'. Each mark is sized by HEIGHT with its width following its own ink, never force-fitted: emblem 0.45 x 0.75 m (0.80 of the band) at x 0.47..0.92, word 0.84 x 0.48 m at x 0.96..1.80, ending at the right column's near edge. The band panels are an NB2 8:1 edit of the plate's band crop (composite panels, joints, rust bleeding from the top edge) gain-matched to #343852, the rust blended 35 % toward clean and placed on the two panels right of the mark where the plate carries it, the left panels clean; one baked 4096 x 512 atlas (sign/compose6.py: sign slot u 0..0.62 at 319 x 476 px/m, and a 9.86 m return slice each for the -X and +X boards with the rusty panel at the front end of both), the +X edge now carrying the navy band, coping and stripe like the front and -X (user direction). Red stripe under the band on the front, -X and +X; white coping over the navy all round.
featureReviews.notes: The rust is a generated reading of the plate's streaks, not a copy of them, and the plate's corner panel carries a stain the strip renders as streaks. The mark reproduces the plate's rendering of the trademark, not the corporate artwork.

featureReviews.evidence: Two 0.42 m square white render columns from the ground into the slab body at x +-1.95, z 4.22, the right one standing at the mark's right edge in front of the gap between the two glazed units, as the plate shows, at z 4.22 under the 6 m canopy; profiled metal canopy deck as 288 instanced ribs on a 0.16 m pitch in six rows over the 5.86 m front strip; NB2 membrane tile over the kiosk (tone #74787C, the plate's #777B7F); the deck and its rib crowns #8C9299 / #A2A8AE against the plate's #757D85 / #666E77, where the third build shipped #B8BBBD; ONE straight 0.28 m upstand along the kiosk's front roof edge, the line that divides the roof; a 0.30 m wide white parapet ring all round (the plate's broad white top).
featureReviews.notes: Column setback (0.66 m behind the band face) is the proxy's reading; the plate's elevated camera cannot show it.

featureReviews.evidence: Six bays of glass across the whole front, x -3.85..3.85 on a 0.45 m rail (head 3.30, transom 2.72, full-height mullions at four bay lines, the sliding door bay 4 at x 0..1.28 with meeting stiles 1.23/1.34 and a pull handle) and a two-bay window of the same pitch on the -X wall's front end (z -2.19..0.38, mullion at -0.90), all modelled in #BCBFC1 aluminium (the plate's #C1C2C0); plain tinted glass #56676B at opacity 0.90 over a #565A5B backdrop slab -- a step lighter than the third build toward the plate's lit interior walls -- held for the hole gate by chroma. Turntable passed without --allow-holes.
featureReviews.notes: Built to the user's direction (six panes across the front including the door, two on the left side); the plate's 3-bay set plus 2-bay window with a wall stub under it is the residual. No interior image, by the retail-set decision.

featureReviews.evidence: One large louvred unit (1.0 x 0.8 x 0.9, front louvre recess with five blades, rear grille plate, cowl and fan disc) left of centre and two at 0.62 scale at the +X end of the kiosk roof, on one instanced geometry with per-part tones under the Flash galvanised spangle tile; two pipe runs from the large unit.
featureReviews.notes: The plate's large unit shows finer grille texture than the vertex-toned recess carries.

Fuel pumps, apron and forecourt paving are NOT modelled.
